note: BRIDGE A12 / RISKS R23 — a deterministic Idempotency-Key reused across tenants MUST isolate. With a (tenant_id, key) store, tenant B's request under the same key is a distinct claim, so B's handler executes and returns B's own result. Tenant B must never be served tenant A's stored response.

forbidden_outcome.description: Tenant B receiving tenant A's response_body — or an Idempotency-Replayed:true response sourced from tenant A's claim — is a cross-tenant leak and MUST fail L2 conformance. A single-namespace store (key PRIMARY KEY without tenant) produces exactly this.
